answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11207 Country: United States of America Title: Assalamu Alaykum W.W. I work in restaurent where we sell pork meat along with other meats and vegetables.So is it Islamically good to work there? And is it good to own such type of restaurent? Question: Assalamu Alaykum W.W. I work in restaurent where we sell pork meat along with other meats and vegetables.So is it Islamically good to work there? And is it good to own such type of restaurent? Answer ID: 11207 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 302/302=M/1430) If the jobs assigned to you in the restaurant includes selling pork, then as per the Shariah this job is haram and unlawful, but the entire salary will not be regarded unlawful. Alos, it is sin to own such type of restaurant. If you have any alternative lawful job, you should immediately leave this job, otherwise once you manage to get a satisfactory job you should leave it altogether. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
